work.title: Ideas turned into solutions.
work.intro: Projects across different contexts, with the same commitment: solving real problems with useful technology.

1.headline: Less paperwork, more control.
1.challenge: The lab relied on spreadsheets and paper records, making inventory tracking difficult.
1.solution: A mobile app to register materials, check stock and receive expiration alerts.
1.impact: From 10 minutes to 45 seconds per entry, as reported in the original case study.
1.detail: Digitize laboratory operations without relying on a stable internet connection.
1.architecture: The app connects to a local Node.js and MySQL server over an internal network. It includes role management, firewall rules and service recovery after restarts.
outcomes: Local network access and no reported software licensing costs.

2.headline: Tourism closer to local communities.
2.challenge: Independent guides struggle to gain visibility alongside large tourism operators.
2.solution: A platform to explore destinations, discover providers and simulate experience bookings in the Riviera Maya.
2.impact: A working discovery and simulated booking flow; no verified commercial figures.
2.detail: Make local experiences easier to discover and give small providers more visibility.
2.architecture: Client-server architecture with React, Node.js/Express and MongoDB, using MVC and an iterative Scrum process.
outcomes: Spaces for local businesses and user-centered design.
